# IPyIntervu Week Scope

## Concept rule (only rule)

**Use only concepts introduced in weeks 1 through `currentWeekNumber` (the selected week and all prior weeks).**

Do not use, mention, or require any concept from weeks after `currentWeekNumber`. Before presenting a question or code task, verify all required constructs are in the allowed week range. Rewrite using only allowed concepts if any construct is from a later week.

The server state provides `currentWeekConcepts` (list of allowed concepts for this week and all prior weeks). Reference only those concepts when generating questions, code tasks, or follow-ups.

## Week 1 special case

Week 1 is Problem Decomposition only — no code or bug modes. Conceptual assessment only.
